name: Pixcoin
description: Gold Coins commonly found throughout Planarcadia and Astropolis. They can be exchanged for items, but there is a weekly cap on how many you can obtain.
story:
A currency formed from accumulated fragments of Wishpower, symbolizing intelligent life's stereotypical view of "wealth."
According to the Vehicle City Accord ratified in Arcadian Calendar Year 1985, universal equivalents pegged to Wishpower can also circulate in Astropolis.

"The best currency investment these days: earn Arcadia Coins, spend credits!"
